components.prompt: Front view of a 1930s military field radio station made of two matching wooden boxes standing side by side and touching: the left box is the receiver with three round dials, knobs and a valve tube on top; the right box is the transmitter with one large tuning dial, two round meters and a toggle switch; symmetrical, straight-on, both boxes the same height
1930s radio operator headphones with two round metal earpieces, a curved spring headband and a coiled cord, three-quarter view

The nine-storey Yan'an Pagoda, an octagonal brick pagoda standing on top of a small loess hill with a few trees, distant three-quarter view

The facade of a Shaanbei loess cave dwelling (yaodong): an arched opening in a loess cliff with a wooden lattice window filling the arch and a small wooden door, front view, a little loess wall around it
An old kerosene oil lamp with a glass chimney, lit with a small flame
A 1940s broadcast microphone: a round mesh capsule held by springs inside a ring, on a short desk stand, front three-quarter view

scenes.narration: 红军的第一部电台，只有半部。{a}1930年底龙冈一战缴获它时，{b}发报机已经坏了——只能收，不能发。
这是我心中的思政课，{a}就从这半部电台讲起。
只能听，那就听。{a}1931年1月，红军第一支无线电队成立，{b}王诤任队长。{c}他们日夜监听敌台，{d}帮红军打赢了第二次反“围剿”的第一仗。

又过十年，{a}1950年，陕甘两省邮电人员训练班成立，{b}这就是西安邮电大学的前身。{c}从那以后，接住电波的，是一届届西邮人。

讲哪段历史，为什么讲，{a}得由我们自己定。
当年的报务员只能听。{a}今天，轮到我们发报：{b}请党放心，{c}强国有我。
